purpose: T09 photon likelihood as a development binding in Python, recipe reco.light.channel-likelihood/1 (decisions.md, U12 A; not a native backend, whose gap stays open), stage 1: the readout light-readout/1 (per channel the state live-hit, live-unhit, dead or disabled, the charge, the first time and the readout's saturated flag, side by side), the charge-only all-channel likelihood of the hep-detector photon-likelihood reference on the stated analytic light model of t04-values-v4.md section 4.3 (every live channel; hit and no-hit terms on one threshold model, so their probabilities sum to one per channel, checked at the reported point; saturated channels censored; dead and disabled channels excluded, never unhit), a fit from one seed for vertex, direction and visible energy with the inverse observed Hessian as its uncertainty, the product light-likelihood-product/1; stage 2: the time term (the first-arrival density with the noise rate included, joint with the charge, so charge and time are never assumed independent), the fit's seventh parameter t0 seeded from the data after the charge-only fit, the product light-likelihood-product/2 (charge-only kept as the default option, unchanged), and on the scoring side t04-values-v4.md section 9.3's two deterministic checks at the 50 fixed likelihood points against an independently written evaluation that shares no code with the recipe with a reader that refuses a malformed or incomplete product and recomputes ln L and the probability check; stage 3: multistart seeds of the joint fit derived from the data alone (stage 2's start first, its reversed, turned and mirrored variants and the charge seed), their count and choice rule in a budget file recorded by hash, the best converged start reported with every start recorded in the product light-likelihood-product/3, and on the scoring side the truth-start fit (the same recipe started at truth, never on the data side, never a result) with the wrong-minimum clauses and fit-failure readings beside the pulls; stage 4: the topology step, the two-source hypothesis H2 on the joint likelihood with both sources' light summed per channel and each source its own t0, fitted from the starts of a topology budget recorded by hash (from the data and H1's fit alone), and the choice of t04-values-v4.md section 7 (H2 if and only if 2 (lnL_2 - lnL_1) >= 30, the frozen penalty) in the product light-likelihood-product/4, with on the scoring side the two-source control's files and the mis-ID, mirrored, reversed and D_bar readings; and on the scoring side the harness that hands out the frozen generator t09-sphere/1's events as files and the development readings; D3 stage 5, examples/reconstruction-photon-likelihood, which generates a few synthetic events, fits them (multistart, then topology) and checks the product; D4 build E1, t04-values-v4.md section 9.4's two negative checks: the single-photon-density variant (E1b) as a whole configuration of its own (t09-sphere-1-single-photon.configuration.json, the main file's constants under its own format; the hit channel's time term one photon's arrival density in place of the first arrival, every other part the main recipe's; the product light-likelihood-product/3-single-photon; each reader refuses the other's configuration and product), and on the scoring side the relabelling of the dead control's dead channels as live-unhit for the frozen recipe to fit unchanged (E1a) and both fires rules read as development readings; every result labelled shared-model closure; optional, required by no skill
